features.description: The plugin loads in OpenCode v2 without errors and announces tracing
steps: Place the built plugin under .opencode/plugins/ in a test project
Start opencode (or run: opencode service restart) and run: opencode plugin list
Confirm the plugin id appears active and startup logs show the Langfuse tracing banner with the configured host and no load errors

features.description: One Langfuse trace is created per OpenCode session with a root observation
steps: Configure credentials (env vars per the accepted config ADR)
Run: opencode run "use bash to run: echo hi"
Fetch the newest trace from the Langfuse API and verify: one trace per session, root observation input contains the user prompt and output contains the final assistant response

features.description: One generation observation per primary model request, auxiliary requests tagged
steps: Run a multi-turn session that also produces a title generation
Verify the trace contains one generation per primary agent-loop model request with the true model id
Verify auxiliary requests (title/compaction/generate kinds) are either separate tagged generations or recorded as metadata, never silently merged into primary generations

features.description: Token usage is recorded on generations
steps: Run a session and fetch the newest trace
Verify each primary generation carries usageDetails (input/output, cache fields where the provider reports them) matching the usage OpenCode reports for that request
Verify usage comes from the capture point decided in R1, not guessed

features.description: Cost is self-computed from token usage and a resolved price
steps: Run a session on a model with a resolvable price and verify costDetails on generations equal usage × resolved per-token price
Run a session on a model with no resolvable price and verify cost is omitted with a one-time warning (not a zero)
Verify host-reported cost values are never trusted without the proof required by AGENTS.md constraint 2

features.description: Tool calls become observations with error level on failure
steps: Run a session with successful tool calls and one intentional failure (non-zero bash exit)
Verify each tool call produces an observation named for the tool
Verify the failing call has level=ERROR / isError=true derived from execute.after status, not from payload content

features.description: Context compaction is recorded as a span
steps: Drive a session long enough to compact (or otherwise trigger a compaction request)
Verify the trace records a compaction span tagged with kind=compaction

features.description: Trace-level scores are attached when the session ends
steps: Run a multi-tool session with one intentional failure and fetch the newest trace
Verify all five scores: tool_call_count, turn_count, total_tool_errors, tool_success_rate, session_had_errors — and that their values match the observed run

features.description: Privacy presets and redaction govern every captured payload
steps: Set preset metadata-only and verify the trace contains no prompt/response/tool content
Set preset full-debug, seed a session with a fake API key in tool output, and verify the key is redacted in the captured payload
Verify per-field env overrides (LANGFUSE_CAPTURE_*) still take precedence over the preset

features.description: Credentials resolve per the accepted config decision and absence degrades cleanly
steps: With no credentials configured, start opencode in a project with the plugin and verify it loads, stays disabled, and states why (no crash, no trace attempts)
Set credentials via the accepted mechanism (env vars and/or config file per ADR-0001) and verify tracing activates
Verify credentials never appear in traces or logs

features.description: Source/git metadata is recorded on the trace
steps: Run a session inside this git repository and fetch the newest trace
Verify trace metadata includes source_type, git_branch, git_commit, and repo identity sourced from ctx.vcs
Verify a metadata-override file at the repo root can override/add the documented keys

features.description: Slash commands for status and connectivity test are available
steps: Confirm /langfuse-status reports config source, host, masked public key, preset, capture flags, and last runtime error
Run /langfuse-test and verify a standalone test trace arrives in Langfuse

features.description: Subagent/child-session runs are grouped under the parent session trace
steps: Run a session that spawns a subagent (per the R3 findings on OpenCode's child-session model)
Verify child traces are named and grouped under the parent session with parent linkage, or the feature is consciously descoped with the R3 evidence recorded
